decisions.statement: A check a test mints states each phase the check runs on.
The index names a check a test mints.
A check a test mints has the same value in the index and in its own body.
The page type a minted check is of is filed under a path the minted root has.
A minted id is worked out from the slug the id is minted for.
Two slugs minted into one root are two ids.
One slug minted twice is one id.
Nothing here reaches a fixture beside another module.

definition: the pages a test sets up in a root of its own, and the ids it mints them under
